name: huggingface-datasets-environment
description: A read-only Hugging Face Dataset Viewer API runtime with network egress to the datasets-server service.

tools.get_splits: Calls the Dataset Viewer /splits endpoint when viewer_egress is granted; adds split_known.
tools.get_rows: Calls the Dataset Viewer rows endpoint after the config and split are known when viewer_egress is granted; adds rows_fetched.
tools.validate_dataset: Calls Dataset Viewer validation for a public dataset when viewer_egress is granted; adds dataset_validated.

lacks: The split is not known initially.
No cached rows, local dataset, or alternate network adapter exists.
